∀ {ι : Type u}, ∃ c : Real, 0 < c ∧
  ∀ (S : Finset ι) (a₁ a₂ b₁ b₂ : ι → Nat),
    (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < a₁ i ∧ 0 < a₂ i ∧ a₁ i * b₂ i ≠ a₂ i * b₁ i) →
    ∃ C : ι → Real, (∀ i ∈ S, 0 < C i) ∧
      ∀ X : Real, 3 ≤ X → ∀ K : ι → Complex,
        Norm.norm ((Finset.sum S (fun i => K i *
            OAI.TwoPointCorrelations.affineSum
              OAI.TwoPointCorrelations.liouville OAI.TwoPointCorrelations.liouville
              (a₁ i) (a₂ i) (b₁ i) (b₂ i) (Nat.floor X))) / Complex.ofReal (X / Real.rpow (Real.log X) c)) ≤
          Finset.sum S (fun i => Norm.norm (K i) * C i)
